verdict.rationale: Gunderson Dettmer is a law firm, so scheduling recurring jobs or workflows is a software-automation axis outside its category. Its client tools (ChatGD, D&O portal, contract generator, GDHQ, SMART Request intake) are on-demand document and intake tools. Nothing in the evidence shows any scheduling or recurring-workflow capability that would make the axis apply.
